reported_fitted_or_used.name: New spindle encoder
reported_fitted_or_used.source_line: The owner reports using Mesa 5i20, 7i33, 7i42, and 7i37 hardware. A new spindle encoder was added for rigid tapping. Most of the left-hand control panel was retained, leaving much of the machine hardware-controlled. A sealed kiosk keyboard and mouse were added, primarily for NativeCAM. The owner also describes a LinuxCNC trajectory-planner change that exposed which axis was moving, so an independent Z feed override could reproduce a feature of the Hurco control that his father valued.
